confirm_enable_rest.title: REST API disabled on {host}
confirm_enable_rest.description:
HTTPS REST API (:4343) on **{host}** returned HTTP 503 (`REST API Service is not enabled`).

Enabling REST API will execute these exact CLI commands over SSH (`:22`):
`configure terminal` -> `allow-rest-api` -> `end` -> `commit apply` -> `write memory`

Choose whether to apply that configuration change or leave the AP untouched and run strictly read-only over SSH.

filters.title: SSID & client tracking filters
filters.description: Select which SSIDs and Wi-Fi clients should create Home Assistant entities.

data_description.tracked_ssids: Selected SSIDs create enabled trackers; leave empty to track all discovered SSIDs. You can also type custom/scheduled SSIDs.
data_description.unselected_ssid_mode: Ignore skips unselected SSIDs completely; Disable registers them disabled in the Entity Registry.
data_description.track_new_clients: Disable to create newly seen clients disabled until manually enabled.
data_description.track_unnamed_clients: Disable to ignore clients with an empty hostname (common for IoT devices).
data_description.include_wired_clients: Keep off unless you want wired Ethernet devices plugged into AP downlink ports.
data_description.min_signal: Ignore weak neighbor associations below this SNR value (0 disables).
data_description.exclude_macs: Comma-separated list of MAC addresses to exclude completely.
data_description.enable_roaming_sensors: Adds diagnostic Access Point and SSID sensors per client (disabled by default to reduce entity count).
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll Aruba for AP and client updates (5–300 s).
data_description.consider_home: Grace period before marking a sleeping smartphone away (prevents Wi-Fi power-save flapping).
